scripts.video:render: npm run sync && cp captures/demo.webm captures/beats.json video/public/ && cp captures/home.png brand/*.svg brand/*.wav video/public/ 2>/dev/null; remotion render video/src/index.ts DemoFilm video/out/demo.mp4 --public-dir video/public ${REMOTION_BROWSER:+--browser-executable "$REMOTION_BROWSER"}
scripts.ppt: npm run sync && node tools/build-slides.mjs && marp ppt/slides.md --no-stdin --html --theme-set ppt/theme.css --pdf --pdf-notes --allow-local-files -o ppt/slides.pdf
scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium ffmpeg && mkdir -p video/public/fonts && cp brand/fonts/*.otf video/public/fonts/
